purpose: Create a snapshot-bound factual behavior map for one enumerable source closure.

input.closure_rule: Include the root, each direct repository caller and callee, each in-scope function relation, and each behavior-bearing state dependency.

rules: Use one function row for each mapped function.
Use one state row only when state changes behavior, crosses a boundary, persists, owns a resource, or carries a secret.
Exclude ordinary locals and syntax that source tools recover without semantic judgment.
Use one relation row for every call, delegation, read, write, and default dependency between declared IDs.
Never hide a missing relation in prose.
Use source_confirmed, runtime_confirmed, disputed, or unknown for confidence.
Give each source claim an exact file span and whole-file SHA-256.
Mark unsupported detail as unknown outside closure.
Do not decide whether mapped behavior is good, safe, or desirable.
Use one independent coverage checker to find omissions, extras, duplicate IDs, stale hashes, bad spans, and mislinked relations.
Do not create a graph database.
done: Each function and state ID exists once.
Each relation endpoint resolves to one declared ID.
Each in-scope call and delegation has one relation row.
Each direct repository caller and callee of the root appears.
Each source hash matches the repository snapshot.
One independent coverage check reports no omission, extra row, duplicate ID, stale hash, bad span, or mislinked relation.
